description: Green Home Score sub-score mappings (0-100). Every mapping never decreases as the state improves. Documented in docs/SCORE.md.

energy_efficiency.input: sap_score (EPC SAP rating; the documented rating-based measure behind the A-G band)

energy_intensity.input: x = (baseline gas + baseline elec) / floor_area_m2 (tagged baseline or user reading; never EPC modelled energy)
energy_intensity.rule: 100 * (p90 - x) / (p90 - p10), clipped to 0-100; p10/p90 read from configs/score_params.json
missing_when: gas boiler recorded without mains gas

insulation.input: EPC walls / roof / floor element ratings
insulation.rule: weighted mean of rating_points over elements that apply; not_applicable elements are skipped and the remaining weights renormalised

heating.rule: rating_points[heating_rating]; a heat pump scores at least heat_pump_floor (EPC rating is cost-based, not carbon-based)

renewables.rule: PV with roof coverage >= 50% -> 100, any other PV -> 60, none -> 0; plus solar thermal / wind additions; capped at 100. Heat pumps count under heating.

smart_controls.note: smart = time and temperature zone control (TTZC) proxy, provenance assumption (D4)

missing.rule: weights stay fixed; a missing part is scored 50 for the headline and 0 / 100 for range_low / range_high; more than 2 missing parts -> score unavailable
